title: MCP domain tool response payloads
description: Typed domain success and failure payloads serialized into CallToolResult text content, distinct from the transport envelope and JSON-RPC protocol errors.

domainErrorEnvelope.description: Typed tool/domain failure payload carried inside serialized tools/call text content.

domainSuccessPayload.description: One domain success payload serialized into tools/call text content.

domainFailurePayload.description: One domain/tool failure payload serialized into tools/call text content.
